deadline.value: Apply by December 10, 2026 (same for domestic and international applicants).

gre_subject.value: The Physics GRE is optional; it has been optional since 2018 and may be submitted after the deadline.
gre_subject.quote: Since the Fall of 2018, the GRE subject test in Physics has been optional.

gre_general.value: The GRE General is not required for Autumn 2027 applicants; scores may be sent optionally.
gre_general.quote: The GRE General is not required for applications received in 2026 for admission in Autumn 2027.

also.quote: the optional General and Physics GRE scores

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 79 minimum (550 paper-based) for applicants whose native language is not English.
toefl_min.quote: equivalent to a total score of 79 on the internet-based TOEFL (IBT)

english_waiver.value: Exempt only by citizenship of, or a bachelor's from, a listed English-speaking country; India is not listed.
english_waiver.quote: from one of these English-speaking countries are exempt

fee_waiver.value: Limited opportunities, applied for through the Ohio State Graduate School, not the department.
fee_waiver.quote: There are limited opportunities for fee waivers.

funding.value: Admitted students are submitted for University Fellowships or offered TA/RA support, and the department supports all graduate students through their PhD.
funding.quote: we fully support all of our graduate students from entry through completion of their PhDs

entry_route.value: A 4-year bachelor's degree is enough to apply.
entry_route.quote: An earned 4-year baccalaureate or higher degree from an accredited college or university prior to beginning graduate studies.

supervisor.value: Not stated on the pages checked

notes: Astronomy is a separate application from Physics.
